notes.title: Lost in Space - the First Adventure - Updated Demo!
notes.notes: [p]We've done a major overhaul of the visuals and added lots of QOL improvements. This includes the ability to control the gameplay with your choice of keyboard, mouse or joystick. We've added rebinding to the keyboard and joystick controls so you can customize your gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: REBROADCAST - Watch the Developers play!
notes.notes:
Watch as Twitch Streamer lunerraa joins our lead developer, Dustin and plays our upcoming game: "Lost in Space - The Adventure Game." The game is a licensed version of the classic 1960's TV show "Lost in Space." It's a point and click adventure game in which you'll play as the three main characters from the show: Will Robinson, Doctor Smith and Robot.

"Lost in Space - The Adventure Game" is a licensed adaptation of the classic 1960's TV show. It's a classic point and click adventure game where you'll get to play as all three of the main characters: Will Robinson, Dr. Smith and Robot. Players will be entertained by an all new adventure along with lots of challenging puzzles.

The game is in development but the demo is available now on our Steam page.

notes.title: Updated game demo - new cinematics!
notes.notes: We've added all new cinematics to the beginning and ending of our game demo. The game now begins with an introductory cinematic that introduces you to all of the members of the Jupiter 2 before players jump into the gameplay. And the ending cinematic has been overhauled as well. There's no new gameplay in the demo but there are lots of new graphical elements to make the experience even more immersive!
